title: fix(spec): four metadata type descriptions Setup shows are plain admin sentences
body:
Fixes #23808

Clause-②: no

## What changed

Setup shows four `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` descriptions (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`) under each type's title. Each one is now a single plain sentence for an administrator: what the items are and what you do with them. The ADR vocabulary moved into the comment beside each registry row.

| type | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `api` | Declarative HTTP endpoint — a stable URL and policy layer over an existing pipeline (ADR-0121) | A stable HTTP URL that other systems call to run a flow or work with records in the app |
| `doc` | Package documentation — flat Markdown items (ADR-0046) | A help page written in Markdown that a package ships or you write yourself |
| `book` | Documentation navigation spine — ordered groups with derived membership (ADR-0046 §6) | A table of contents that groups help pages into ordered sections |
| `capability` | Package-declared authorization capability — the DEFINITION side of ADR-0066 D1 (grants live on permission sets; requirements on resources) | A permission a package defines; you grant it through permission sets |

`capability` uses the wording the Setup review proposed for this type, word for word.

- **Generated translations:** `pnpm i18n:extract` regenerated `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`. The zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES values for these four leaves were hand-written translations of the old wording. They are rewritten as plain sentences in each locale. AGENTS.md allows editing translated-locale values in place; no keys were added or removed. A second extract run is a no-op, and the `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` tables did not change, because the leaves are authored and not echoes.
- **Pin:** `bare-type-display-echo-decisions.test.ts` records the four description rows against their new `en` source and new renderings, with reasons. The KEPT-token assertion now keeps `HTTP`/`URL` (api) and `Markdown` (doc). The token-predicate dark control moved to tokens that are still in the prose. A new assertion checks that none of the four descriptions carries `ADR-`, a `D` plus digit decision id, `finding F`, `emit()`, `kernel` or `§`, in the registry, `en` or any translated locale. It also has a dark control that fires on the replaced prose. No assertion was deleted.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/spec` patch and `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch. The generated bundles ship in its `dist`.

No key, type, schema or accept/refuse result changes.

## Where the description reaches an admin

`MetadataManager`'s type info (`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts`, `description: entry.description`) feeds the `/meta` types listing. The REST `/meta` handler translates it per locale through `resolveMetadataTypeDescription` (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, `translateMetaTypesResponse`). The Setup and Studio metadata pages both read that listing. No other runtime reader of these four strings was found. The similar wording on `stack.zod.ts` `docs`/`books` `.describe()` is author-facing schema documentation, so it is outside this card.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's measurement, `grep -E "description: '[^']*(ADR-|\bD[0-9]\b|finding F|emit\(\)|kernel)"` over the registry's `{ type: '…' }` lines, gives 4 hits at `74b436263` and 0 after this change.
- #23802 (the engine-side half, with its acceptance lint) is a separate card and stays open. Whichever PR lands second regenerates the shared metadata-forms files.
- Patch round (head `a8dd6f769f`, at the seat's review): the `api` sentence names only what executes, because `endpoint.zod.ts` rejects `script` and `proxy` at publish. The `doc` and `book` sentences drop "a package ships" as the only source, because both rows are `allowRuntimeCreate: true`. The translations, the decisions test and the changeset follow.
- The new sentences end without a full stop, matching the other registry descriptions (`seed`, `picklist`, `mapping`, `dataset`). The card's example sentence has one.

## Verification (head `b625ac4c`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 70 files / 1092 tests passed. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 88 families. 86 exited 0, including `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:docs`, `check:authorable-surface` and `check:api-surface`. 2 exited 3 on missing prerequisites in this container, so they were NOT MEASURED locally and are left to CI:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: shallow clone, the pinned fixture commit is unreachable.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: not every workspace package is built.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 88 accounted for, 0 UNRUN.
